svg.title: Gating a sparse part
svg.desc: The countermelody rests for its first 15 seconds and between phrases. 36% of its blocks fall under the relative gate at -51.1 LUFS, so its integrated loudness of -40.8 LUFS sits above the plain mean of -42.7 LUFS over every block.
svg.text: The gate measures a part while it plays
Momentary loudness of “Countermelody (tenor sax)” in Clichê · shaded blocks fall under the gate (36% of the song)
